newsitem.title: CHINA: China coal mine blast injures 17.
newsitem.headline: China coal mine blast injures 17.

text.p: A coal mine explosion in central China's Henan province has injured 17 miners and caused more than one million yuan ($120,000) in damage, the China Daily said on Friday.
The disaster occurred when workers at a small private mine on the outskirts of Zhengzhou city illegally blasted a tunnel into an adjacent state-run coal mine, the newspaper said.
Police had arrested five suspects, it said without giving further details.
About 10,000 people are killed each year in mining accidents in China, which has tens of thousands of small and inefficient coal mines.
Operators at many of these mines ignore basic safety precautions and use poorly trained workers.
